refresh_policy.rationale: Collection runs in the owner's own signed-in www.tiktok.com session: every request is a GET to TikTok's own web API made from inside the page, signed by TikTok's own page scripts, one at a time, 1.5 to 3 seconds apart, at most 900 per run and 200 pages per list. TikTok's terms do not permit automated access, so the owner starts every run and no run happens in the background. A sign-in prompt, a bot check, an unsigned request, a rate limit or a server error ends the run without a retry. Nothing that writes (follow, like, post, comment) is reachable.

public_listing.rationale: Built from recorded response shapes of one test account; not yet run end to end against a live TikTok session.

streams.name: profile
streams.description: The signed-in owner's own TikTok profile. Follower, following, like and video counts come from the owner's own videos, so they are null for an account that has posted none. The email address, phone number and sign-in settings are not collected.

display.label: Your TikTok profile
display.detail: Your user id, handle, nickname, bio, avatar, whether the account is private, and your follower, following, like and video counts.

id.description: TikTok's own numeric user id, stable for the life of the account.

sec_uid.description: TikTok's public secure user id, used in profile links.

avatar_url.description: Address of the avatar image TikTok served. Null when absent.

follower_count.description: Accounts following the owner, when collected.

following_count.description: Accounts the owner follows, when collected.

like_count.description: Likes the owner's videos have received, when collected.

video_count.description: Videos the owner has posted, when collected.

created_at.description: When the account was created, in UTC.

streams.name: videos
streams.description: Videos the owner posted, newest first, with their caption, length, who may see them, and their counts when collected. Every run reads the whole list again so the counts stay current. The video files are not collected.

display.label: Your TikTok videos
display.detail: Each video's caption, when you posted it, its length, who can see it, and its views, likes, comments, shares, saves and reposts.

created_at.description: When the video was posted, in UTC. This is the stream's cursor and consent time field.

caption.description: The video's caption, including hashtags as written.

duration_seconds.description: Length of the video in seconds.

privacy.description: Who may see the video: everyone, friends only, or only the owner.

streams.name: likes
streams.description: Videos the owner liked, newest first: who posted each and its caption. TikTok does not say when a video was liked, so this stream cannot be limited to a date range. Every run reads the whole list again to TikTok's own end signal. The video files are not collected.

display.label: Videos you liked on TikTok
display.detail: The videos you liked: who posted each, its caption and when it was posted.

author_id.description: The numeric user id of the account that posted the video.

author_unique_id.description: The handle of the account that posted the video, without the @.

author_nickname.description: The display name of the account that posted the video.

video_created_at.description: When the video was posted, in UTC. Not when it was liked.

streams.name: favorites
streams.description: Videos the owner saved to Favorites, newest first: who posted each and its caption. TikTok does not say when a video was saved, so this stream cannot be limited to a date range. Every run reads the whole list again to TikTok's own end signal. The video files are not collected. Which Favorites collection a video sits in is not collected: the web API calls observed for this source list collections but not their contents.

display.label: Your TikTok Favorites
display.detail: The videos you saved to Favorites: who posted each, its caption and when it was posted. Which collection a video sits in is not collected.

author_id.description: The numeric user id of the account that posted the video.

author_unique_id.description: The handle of the account that posted the video, without the @.

author_nickname.description: The display name of the account that posted the video.

video_created_at.description: When the video was posted, in UTC. Not when it was saved.

streams.name: favorite_collections
streams.description: The collections the owner made in Favorites: name and how many videos each holds. Which videos are in a collection is not collected.

display.label: Your TikTok Favorites collections
display.detail: The name of each collection you made in Favorites and how many videos it holds.

item_count.description: Videos in the collection when collected.

streams.name: following
streams.description: Accounts the owner follows: handle, display name and id. Every run reads the whole list again; the stream fails rather than reports complete when TikTok cuts the list short.

display.label: Accounts you follow on TikTok
display.detail: Each account's handle, display name and id, and whether it is verified or private.

id.description: TikTok's own numeric user id of the account.

sec_uid.description: TikTok's public secure user id of the account.

verified.description: Whether TikTok shows the account as verified.

streams.name: followers
streams.description: Accounts that follow the owner: handle, display name and id. Every run reads the whole list again; the stream fails rather than reports complete when TikTok cuts the list short.

display.label: Your TikTok followers
display.detail: Each follower's handle, display name and id, and whether it is verified or private.

id.description: TikTok's own numeric user id of the account.

sec_uid.description: TikTok's public secure user id of the account.

verified.description: Whether TikTok shows the account as verified.

reason_display_messages.tiktok_auth_failed: TikTok needs you to sign in again before this can continue.
reason_display_messages.tiktok_bot_check: TikTok showed a check or refused a request, so collection stopped without retrying. Open TikTok yourself and make sure your account works normally before running this again.
reason_display_messages.tiktok_request_unsigned: TikTok's page did not sign a request the way it signs its own, so nothing more could be read safely. TikTok may have changed its site; please report this if it keeps happening.
reason_display_messages.tiktok_rate_limited: TikTok asked us to slow down, so collection stopped early to protect your account. What was collected is saved. Wait a while before running this again.
reason_display_messages.tiktok_server_error: TikTok's servers had a problem partway through. What was collected is saved; try again later.
reason_display_messages.tiktok_interrupted: The TikTok page stopped answering partway through. What was collected is saved; try again.
reason_display_messages.tiktok_run_limit_reached: This run reached its safety limit on requests. What was collected is saved; the next run continues.
reason_display_messages.tiktok_source_unreadable: TikTok answered in a form this connector does not recognise, so this part was not saved as complete. TikTok may have changed its site; please report this.
reason_display_messages.tiktok_api_error: TikTok refused one of the requests, so this part was not saved as complete.
reason_display_messages.tiktok_list_incomplete: TikTok did not show the end of this list, so it was not saved as complete. What was read is saved.

pageshim.login_message: Sign in to TikTok, then return here.
